title: Void Totem
description: Falling into the void with a totem of undying in your hand will now save you from death, teleporting you back to the surface.
body:
Falling into the void with a totem of undying in your hand will now save you from death, teleporting you back to the surface.

Made for NeoForge 21.1.185, on Minecraft Java 1.21.1.
